verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents an official MCP server that gives AI models a standardized interface to its scraping, structured extraction and crawling capabilities. An official GitHub repo (hyperbrowserai/mcp) lists concrete tools such as scrape_webpage, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it, detailed client setup/configuration evidence (e.g., transport and auth for specific MCP clients).
